release.content: pubdeploy 0.3.0 was released on 2026-11-10 from commit 9d632982685afaafd80bd3eb5451075205bab049 with these changes.

rows: Journals are written again: a unit's head is OWNER.REPO.UNIT, lower case, which storage takes, not services/OWNER/REPO/UNIT, which it refused as no such route
PUBKIT_WALK_BY names who a walk is for, before GITHUB_ACTOR and git's user.email, for a host that walks for others
pubkit sync no longer seeds .github/workflows/deploy-check.yml: the convergence engine walks every deploy service; existing callers keep working until each repository removes its own
k8s-deploy.yml builds the image with pubhost's actions/docker-build at pubhost 0.1.0, by commit; the action has moved out of pubkit

release.scope: the published release v0.3.0 of pubdeploy
